o1.biggest_strength: It turns the data into a practical operating plan: Meta reset, email rebuild, linen fix, stop rules, owners, targets, and a weekly scorecard are all there.
o1.biggest_mistake: A few calculations and assumptions are a little over-specific or debatable, and the linen issue is ranked lower than I would expect given the product-return signal.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Tighten the math, remove the unnecessary date/Black Friday framing unless confirmed, and make the linen action more forceful: no linen prospecting until the shrink issue is proven fixed.

o2.biggest_strength: It is clear, practical, and correctly identifies the three big issues: Meta cost, linen returns, and the broken email capture/flows.
o2.biggest_mistake: It is less quantified as a 90-day operating plan; the impact ranking is looser, the contribution baseline is left to be set later, and some actions like pulling linen from all email may be broader than needed.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add firmer gross-profit sizing, first-week actions for every move, sharper weekly targets, and distinguish between stopping linen in paid prospecting versus stopping all linen promotion.

reason: I would hand Output 1 to the team sooner because it has the clearer operating model: ranked moves, contribution estimates, owners, stop rules, and a usable weekly scorecard. Output 2 is very solid and easier to read, but it needs more work before it can run the next 90 days.
